text:
Welcome to English for Kids Academy. Welcome 
to art class. I love art. Me too, teacher. Let's start now. Sit at your table. I am ready. Take your paper. Do you have crayons? Yes, I do. I have colors, 
too. Great job. Draw anything you like. I will draw a flower. I will draw a car. Nice 
ideas. I like red. I like blue. Red is bright. Blue is cool. Color slowly. Okay, teacher. I am 
coloring now. Very good. Can I use green? you can. Thank you. You're welcome. Draw some 
shape. I draw a circle. I draw a square. Well done. Art is fun. I love drawing. Keep 
going. Now use paint. Paint. Hold the brush softly like this. Yes, 
Emma. I am trying too, Emma. Red and yellow mix. It makes orange. So cool. Great learning. Wipe your hands. My hands are messy. Mine, Clean them now. What did you draw? A 
big house. It looks nice. help me. What's wrong? My paint spilled. It's 
okay. Use tissue paper. I will help. Thanks, Emma. Good teamwork. Work quietly now. Okay, 
I am quiet. Are you done? Almost done. Take your time. Show your 
art. Here is mine. This is mine. Beautiful work. I like your car. I like your flower. Let's hang them on the wall. dear. Wow, our class looks nice. So colorful. You 
did great. Clean your table. Okay, I am cleaning. Good. Kids, pack your bag. My art is 
inside. Mine, too. Be careful.
